source.statement: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Shodashavarga chapter — sixteen classical Parashari divisional schemes

anchors.note: Navamsa of Mesha 0° is Mesha (movable counts from itself).
Mesha just past 3°20′ is in the 2nd navamsha, Vrishabha — classical navamsa scheme.
Mesha just before 3°20′ is still the 1st navamsha, Mesha.
Vrishabha 0° (fixed) counts from the 9th from it: Makara.
Mithuna 0° (dual) counts from the 5th from it: Tula.
Karka 0° (movable) counts from itself: Karka.
Meena last navamsha: base Karka(3) + 8 parts = Dhanu(11).
Dashamsha of an odd sign counts from the sign itself.
Dashamsha of an even sign counts from the 9th from it (Vrishabha -> Dhanu).
2nd drekkana is the 5th sign (Mesha 10° -> Simha).
3rd drekkana is the 9th sign (Mesha 20° -> Dhanu).
Trimshamsha odd 0-5° Mesha (Mars).
Trimshamsha odd 5-10° Kumbha (Saturn).
Trimshamsha odd 10-18° Dhanu (Jupiter).
Trimshamsha odd 18-25° Mithuna (Mercury).
Trimshamsha odd 25-30° Tula (Venus).
Trimshamsha even 0-5° Vrishabha (Venus).
Trimshamsha even 5-12° Kanya (Mercury).
Trimshamsha even 12-20° Meena (Jupiter).
Trimshamsha even 20-25° Makara (Saturn).
Trimshamsha even 25-30° Vrishchika (Mars).
Hora of an odd sign 0-15° is Simha (Sun).
Hora of an odd sign 15-30° is Karka (Moon).
Hora of an even sign 0-15° is Karka (Moon).
Hora of an even sign 15-30° is Simha (Sun).
Shashtiamsha of Mesha 0° is Mesha (counts from itself).
Mesha 0°29′59″ still in the 1st shashtiamsha.
Crossing 0°30′ flips the shashtiamsha (RSK_004 sensitivity boundary).
